answer: Each registered identity posts a 400-token bond and a hardware attestation whose signed transcript carries a unique opal tag bound to one physical chip. A forged identity locks the same 400 tokens, forfeits 100% on detection, and waits 30 epochs for bond release. Copying the attestation to new identities costs 400 tokens each, and independent jurors slash every copy, so the fable and trellis of shared stake collapse.
